settings.editor: Log home staining is where we started and what we're known for. We prepare the wood properly, apply premium stains and sealers, and handle the chinking, check sealing, and rot repair that keep a log home tight and protected. We build log homes, so we know what makes a finish last.

settings.title: Craftsmanship rooted in how mountain homes are built

settings.editor: Top Notch Painting is the painting and finishing division of Top Notch Logworks, which has been building log and timber homes and resorts across the Vail and Roaring Fork Valleys since 1999. That background shapes everything we do. We understand how mountain homes are built, how they move, and what high altitude, dry air, and intense sun do to a finish.

settings.title: Your home is in experienced hands

settings.editor: Our crews are trained to our own preparation and finishing standards and led on site by a dedicated project lead. We don't consider a job finished until you've walked it with us and are happy with every room.
